column3: The Hebrew says all their brothers were at their mouth; BSB uses kinsmen at their command.
The Hebrew says without heart and heart and does not name David here; BSB expresses unified purpose and explicitly describes devotion to David.
The Hebrew says beyond the Jordan; BSB specifies east of the Jordan.
The Hebrew describes a whole heart and one heart; BSB uses fully determined and one mind.
The Hebrew calls the providers their brothers; BSB uses relatives.
